actions-list.actionItem: Pursuant to the order of yesterday, the Journal of the proceedings of the Senate was deemed approved to date.
Pursuant to the order of yesterday,the morning hour being deemed expired, and the times for the recognition of the two leaders being reserved.
The following transactions of morning business occurred on today.

H.R. 1276 (Rep. Comer):
        A bill to remove restrictions from a parcel of land in Paducah, Kentucky.

        -- Senate Committee on Energy and Natural Resources discharged by Unanimous Consent.

        -- Passed Senate without amendment by Unanimous Consent.


 H.R. 2069 (Rep. Moore):
        A bill to amend the Federal Funding Accountabilityand Transparency Act of 2006 to ensure that other transaction agreements are reported to USAspending.gov, and for other purposes.

        -- Passed Senate without amendment by Unanimous Consent.


 H.R. 2196 (Rep. Hudson):
        A bill to provide for an extension of the legislative authority of the National Emergency Medical Services Memorial Foundation to establish a commemorative work in the District of Columbia and its environs.

        -- Senate Committee on Energy and Natural Resources discharged by Unanimous Consent.

        -- Passed Senate without amendment by Unanimous Consent.


 H.R. 5334 (Rep. Panetta):
        An act to impose sanctions and other measures withrespect to the Russian Federation, as championed by the late Senator Lindsey O. Graham, and for other purposes.

        -- Considered by Senate.

        -- Passed Senate with an amendment and an amendment to the Title by Yea-Nay Vote. 86 - 11. Record Vote Number: 224 

 

 S.Amdt. 6711 (Sen. Graham):
        To impose sanctions and other measures with respect to the Russian Federation.

        --Amendment SA 6711 proposed by Senator Graham.

        --Amendment SA 6711, under the order of 8/6/2026, agreed to in Senate by Unanimous Consent.

        To amend the title.

        --Amendment SA 6712 proposed by Senator Graham.

        --Amendment SA 6712, under the order of 8/6/2026, agreed to in Senate by Unanimous Consent.

        --Amendment SA 6715 proposed by Senator Paul to Amendment SA 6711.

        --Amendment SA 6715 not agreed to in Senate by Yea-Nay Vote. 32 - 64. Record Vote Number: 223
